answer: The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in trellis, expire in pigment, and gale lists each expiry. An copycat running 157 aliases thus needs 149 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2380 identities would post 3672 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
